privacyBody: We keep temporary copies of chat text and the information used to answer it on our server. This lets a conversation continue when a different AI service answers. Each copy expires 30 days after it is created. Continuing a conversation can create a new copy.
Expired copies cannot be used again. Automatic cleanup runs when our service starts and every five minutes while it is running. If the service is stopped, cleanup resumes when it restarts.

Your saved conversations in History are separate from these temporary copies. They stay until you delete the conversation or your account. Deleting a conversation removes its linked temporary copies too. Deleting your account removes all of your saved conversations and temporary copies.
termsBody: Temporary model context expires after 30 days. You can still reopen an older saved conversation; the app rebuilds context from the recent part of its saved text. The AI may not recall every earlier detail.
You can delete a saved conversation in History or delete your account in Settings. The privacy policy explains how saved conversations and temporary model context are removed.

flow.signInBody: Sign in before starting your trial. Your saved plans stay with your account.
flow.consentBody: Read how Dandelist uses AI and confirm your choice before continuing.
flow.trialBody: Start a 14-day trial without a card. Your trial starts when the server confirms it.
flow.iosBody: On iPhone, the trial uses Apple's two-week introductory offer. Apple confirms eligibility and the offer before the trial starts.
flow.appleTerms: Apple shows the renewal price and cancellation terms before you confirm. Offer eligibility is decided by Apple.
flow.appleCancelled: The Apple offer was cancelled. Your saved plans are still available.
flow.appleIneligible: Apple did not confirm eligibility for this offer. You can still view your saved plans and manage your account.
flow.firstBody: Keep this plan, revisit it later, and decide what to do next.
flow.expiredBody: Choose a plan before starting a new hunt or changing a saved plan. Your saved plans remain available to read.
flow.offerBody: Choose later if you prefer. Your current trial stays available until it ends.
flow.pricesPending: Plan prices are pending. Checkout is unavailable.
flow.error: Couldn't check your access. Your saved plans and account controls are still available.
